title: Consolidate transport policy upgrades and strip deprecated token fields
creator: Asha Patel
description: Reduce long-standing SDK surface complexity by consolidating transport adapters, bumping core HTTP and serialization libraries across Python/JS/Go clients, and removing a deprecated token field (auth_token) that is causing ambiguity in retries and instrumentation. This ticket coordinates library bumps, compatibility shims, migration tooling, perf benchmarks, and a staged rollout with non-breaking defaults.
acceptance_criteria: All three language clients (python, javascript, go) have upgrades to latest vetted transport dependencies (python: httpx 0.24+, requests removal shim; js: undici 6.x / fetch polyfill; go: net/http improvements and httptrace where applicable).
Deprecated 'auth_token' client parameter removed from public constructors; passing it emits a deprecation warning in one minor and is an error in the next major. Migration guide published.
End-to-end CI green for all clients including linters, unit tests, and integration tests against the staging runtime surface.
Latency P50/P95 regression <= 3% in our representative microbenchmarks; token-heavy workloads must show improvements from simplified header instrumentation.
Docs and changelogs updated; automated migration codemods or example snippets available for customers.
Rollout plan documented with canary percentages, fallback plan to previous release, and metrics to observe (error-rate, 5xx, latencies, tokenization deltas).
tasks: Audit current transport stacks across python/js/go and create compatibility matrix
Prepare dependency bump PRs for each client with minimal surface churn
Add deprecation warning path for 'auth_token' and telemetry that records usages
Implement short-lived compatibility shim that maps auth_token -> api_key and emits telemetry
Run microbenchmarks and produce perf report comparing previous and bumped versions
Author migration guide, code snippets, and codemod for python and js
Coordinate release notes and schedule staged rollout (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%)
Post-mortem checklist and rollback runbook prepared
